messages.title: OX Inbox is live
messages.body:
Paul, your OX Inbox is now working.

From today, every answer I give about the Abena Tay Foundation or your Chief of Staff role lands here automatically — on this app, on every device.

What to know:
• Gold edge + red dot = unread. Tap a message to read it.
• '✔ Mark all read' clears the badge. '🧹 Clear read' tidies old items.
• Tap '🔔 Allow notifications' once, then follow Setup Guide 8 for phone pop-ups.

Your move: open 🚀 First 30 Days and start Day 1.

messages.title: How delivery works
messages.body:
Delivery rule (exactly as you instructed):
• Foundation / CoS-role answers → sent here automatically.
• Everything else → stays in the computer chat unless you say "send to my inbox".

This inbox is plain text only — built for reading answers anywhere, anytime, even offline.

messages.title: Monday Work Pack is ready
messages.body:
MONDAY WORK IS READY.

1) Folder: Downloads\MY COS JOURNEY AAT\ATF Funding Week\Mandate
   - Monday Official Work - Session with Her Excellency (decision sheet + week's 7 goals + daily rhythm + relationship system + letters)
   - The Quiet Giver - Street Kindness Content Playbook (the video series, done the ATF way)

2) Your workspace app now has tasks G1-G7 for the week.

3) Positioning sentence (use in every letter and profile):
   "For over 30 years, the Abena Tay Foundation (LBG) has delivered verified, safeguarded programmes for girls, women and vulnerable families across 5 districts of Ghana - measurable outcomes in girls' education, menstrual health and mental wellbeing, aligned with SDGs 3, 4, 5 and 16, trusted in communities international partners cannot reach."

4) Verified numbers (only these leave the office): 1,050+ girls - 800+ women and girls - 10,000 widows - 98 Nsawam women - 15 schools / 10 communities / 5 districts - 30+ years.

5) Monday flow: sit with H.E., walk the decision sheet (11 items), get ticks, then letters move: UN House + UNICEF Ghana, then AWDF, then Embassies.

6) Do not wait for the website fixes - they run in parallel.

messages.title: OX BRAIN + MY TRACKERS ARE LIVE
messages.body:
Installed into your OX app (updates on your phone within ~1 minute):

1. MY TRACKERS (new page in the menu) - the Relationship Strategy + Restructuring broken into 41 small steps. Tick = done (fades). Unticked past the date = RED + counts in the badge. Weekly/monthly steps re-open themselves. Phone badge + red pill show what is open.

2. OX BRAIN v2 - Ask Ox (chat) now answers about: the programme register P01-P10, the 7 Stations, the Playbook sections, Part G harvest, the decades method, RECONNECT, the 3T, cadence, tagging rules, dignitary ladder, the Register, and all project dates. Try asking 'what are the 7 stations' or 'how do I rebuild lost relationships'.

3. Key Dates page + Relationships & Funders page now carry the new system.

4. AUTOMATIC NUDGES (no effort needed): every Friday 7:30am - Relationship Block reminder; every 1st of month - monthly touches + backup. They arrive in this inbox + your phone.

5. One manual step for you (Tracker A05): Command Centre > Import > Downloads\ATF_Command_Centre_backup_2026-09-08_v2.json

Overwhelmed rule: ONE item at a time. The system carries the memory - you carry the action.

messages.title: TOMORROW WED 9 SEP - FOUNDER SITTING 1 (30 min)
messages.body:
Part 0: confirm the official programme register.

BRING: the printed Interview Pack (Part 0 table) OR the Register on your phone.
DO: read the P01-P10 table to Her Excellency - she marks Active / Paused / Finished.
ASK: 0.1 her own order of importance - 0.2 any one programme under different names? - 0.3 which must always be founder-led? - 0.4 are CIN / Daughters Ministries / Jesus Girl Club active or legacy?
RULE: every number she says - ask 'how do we know this?' and mark Verified / To verify / Withdrawn.

After the sitting: tick trkB01 in My Trackers, and send me her answers - the register gets locked in and the playbooks begin.

messages.title: WHILE WE WAIT - 41 FUNDING DOORS OPEN NOW
messages.body:
The waiting period is now working for us. New dossier (PDF, 6 pages, in 06_Programme_Restructuring + CoS folder): 41 portals, registrations and grant doors - Ghana, West Africa, Africa, the world.

DO THESE 10 FIRST (no Founder answers needed):
1. NPOS licence LF-2 - deadline 25 Sep (the master key)
2. GlobalGiving 'Start Due Diligence' - VERIFIED open today
3. UN Partner Portal registration
4. UNGM registration
5. Google for Nonprofits (Ad Grants = USD 10,000/month in free ads)
6. Meta page verification
7. 4 embassy letters: Canada CFLI, Japan GGP, Germany Micro-Projects, Australia DAP
8. AmplifyChange registration - VERIFIED: menstrual health + stigma funding up to GBP 75,000
9. Devex + ReliefWeb profiles (free funder visibility)
10. Girls Not Brides + CIVICUS memberships (free credibility)

All 41 items are loaded in the Command Centre (Tasks t19-t33, Funders, Contacts).
If you imported the Command Centre backup BEFORE this evening - import the updated file again (same name in Downloads), and tell me first if you added records yourself in the browser.

One rule: CHECK WINDOW items must be confirmed on the official page (or embassy email) before submitting. Evidence only.

messages.title: YOUR WEEK: 8 ACTIONS (TODAY TO SAT) - ALL ELIGIBILITY-CHECKED
messages.body:
You CAN achieve something real by Saturday. Here is the week, in order (tick them off in My Trackers > Sprint C):

WED (today): 1. NPOS LF-2 assembly - print forms, complete, list the gaps 2. GlobalGiving 'Start Due Diligence' - with the documents we already have.
THU: 3. UN Partner Portal + UNGM registrations 4. Devex + ReliefWeb profiles 5. Confirm who controls abenatay.org (domain + DNS).
FRI-SAT: 6. Google for Nonprofits request (only if the website audit passes) 7. Draft 4 embassy inquiry emails - Canada CFLI, Japan GGP, Germany, Australia DAP (information requests - her signature is not needed for inquiries) 8. AmplifyChange portal + Girls Not Brides + CIVICUS, then re-import the Command Centre backup.

ELIGIBILITY AUDIT - can we finish what we start? YES, with 3 workarounds:
- Board seating unconfirmed -> applications use the interim management list
- Certified Registrar copies pending -> submit existing documents, certify in parallel
- abenatay.org must pass a live-site audit BEFORE the Google/Meta steps

EVERYTHING is loaded where you work:
- Official Workspace: 8 new sprint tasks (W1-W8) + 3 notices - just open it, no import needed
- Command Centre: sprint tasks re-dated + 3 blocker tasks (t34-t36) - RE-IMPORT the backup if you imported before today evening (same filename in Downloads). Tell me first if you typed records yourself in the browser.
- OX Trackers: Sprint C appears in the badge until done.

Saturday status = 8 registrations/applications in motion while the Founder sittings continue. That is Pillar 1 moving.
